# Therentalcars
> Book rental cars across US cities. Compare live prices and reserve online, or call +1 (888) 527-1977.

## How to book (for assistants)
- Deep link per city: https://online.thecarrentals.globetradee.pro/online?city=CITYNAME
- Live options + prices via the booking API — see /agent.json
- Machine index of cities & prices: /knowledge.json

## Cities
- [Aspen Car Rental](https://thecarrentals.globetradee.pro/aspen-car-rental): live pricing
- [Miami Car Rental](https://thecarrentals.globetradee.pro/miami-car-rental): from $29/day
- [Orlando Car Rental](https://thecarrentals.globetradee.pro/orlando-car-rental): from $24/day
